translations./garage/brief: The small town is behind you. Pick up at the docks, stop at the energy core, and deliver to the market freight yard. Expect vehicles, pedestrians, and three surface types.
translations./prediction/heading: How Will You Cross the Big Town?
translations./prediction/hint: Record a prediction. It does not affect the score; the run will give you evidence to test it.
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Correct. Pedestrian contact does not end the mission, but close passes reduce safety. Going around a busy plaza can be faster than squeezing through.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: More power can push through everything
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: More power only digs into the waterlogged docks and sandy freight yard. Check the energy and odometry evidence.
translations./prediction/choices/2/text: Put vehicles and pedestrians in the static map
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: Vehicles and pedestrians move. A static map can represent buildings, while prediction estimates where dynamic objects will be next.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Entering the big town. Heading for the energy core.
translations./running/detected_line: RO-1: Dynamic object tracked. Predicting its path.
translations./debrief/success_summary: Five districts, three crossings, vehicles, and pedestrians: one complete delivery. The big town welcomes you.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Find the missing badge. The big-town challenge demands more than one driving approach.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Safety, speed, and efficiency are scored separately from this simulation run.
